mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GIFT_DELIVERY_REQUEST ( REQUEST_ID, ORDER_ID, TO_MEMBER_ID, FROM_MEMBER_ID, GIFT_MESSAGE, REQUEST_STATUS, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_GIFT_DELIVERY_REQUEST.NEXTVAL, #{orderId}, #{toMemberId}, #{fromMemberId}, #{giftMessage}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_ID AS requestId, ORDER_ID AS orderId, TO_MEMBER_ID AS toMemberId, FROM_MEMBER_ID AS fromMemberId, GIFT_MESSAGE AS giftMessage, REQUEST_STATUS AS requestStatus, CREATED_DATE AS createdDate, COMPLETED_DATE AS completedDate FROM GIFT_DELIVERY_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}

SELECT REQUEST_ID AS requestId, ORDER_ID AS orderId, TO_MEMBER_ID AS toMemberId, FROM_MEMBER_ID AS fromMemberId, GIFT_MESSAGE AS giftMessage, REQUEST_STATUS AS requestStatus, CREATED_DATE AS createdDate, COMPLETED_DATE AS completedDate FROM GIFT_DELIVERY_REQUEST WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT REQUEST_ID AS requestId, ORDER_ID AS orderId, TO_MEMBER_ID AS toMemberId, FROM_MEMBER_ID AS fromMemberId, GIFT_MESSAGE AS giftMessage, REQUEST_STATUS AS requestStatus, CREATED_DATE AS createdDate, COMPLETED_DATE AS completedDate FROM GIFT_DELIVERY_REQUEST WHERE TO_MEMBER_ID = #{toMemberId} AND REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE GIFT_DELIVERY_REQUEST SET REQUEST_STATUS = #{status}, COMPLETED_DATE = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN SYSDATE ELSE COMPLETED_DATE END WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
